name: AI Assistant with PGVector + Training Mode

parameters.query: SELECT id, content, intent, metadata, pos_count, neg_count FROM rag_chunks ORDER BY embedding <-> '{{ $json.vectorString }}'::vector LIMIT 5;

INSERT INTO conversation_states (session_id, state, updated_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.sessionId }}', '{{ $json.stateJson }}', NOW()) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET state = EXCLUDED.state, updated_at = NOW();
UPDATE rag_chunks SET pos_count = pos_count + 1 WHERE id = '{{ $json.chunkId }}';
UPDATE rag_chunks SET neg_count = neg_count + 1 WHERE id = '{{ $json.chunkId }}';

INSERT INTO feedback_log (session_id, turn_id, chunk_id, feedback_type) VALUES ('{{ $json.sessionId }}', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(turn_id),0)+1 FROM feedback_log WHERE session_id='{{ $json.sessionId }}'), '{{ $json.chunkId }}', '{{ $json.feedbackType }}');
